snippet.title: Battle Europe gameplay (PC Game, 1993)
snippet.description:
Introduction and gameplay for Battle Europe, Dos PC game produced by Comspec in 1993 - http://www.squakenet.com/download/battle-europe/5872/
Shooting Game Battle of Europe is set in World War II, based on strategy.  Your objective: as either Allies or Axis, destroy all tanks of the opposing side on each level to advance to the next.
Played through Dosbox emulation platform.
Recorded with original sound.

Similar videos you may like:
